invariant: Never expose incomplete or corrupted data as valid committed data.

unresolved_usb_boundary: Task 5 connector, CC and ESD candidates are not captured in editable KiCad source
USB attach inrush compliance is unmeasured
pre-configuration, configured and suspend current are unmeasured

state_machine.entry: VBUS absent or outside the accepted window
state_machine.action: eFuse isolates VBUS_HOLD and RUN remains asserted low

state_machine.entry: eFuse ramps VBUS_HOLD and the buck raises 3V3
state_machine.action: supervisors hold RUN low through their release delays

state_machine.entry: VBUS_HOLD, 3V3 and buck power-good remain valid
state_machine.action: RUN releases; firmware may transact only after recovery validation

state_machine.entry: input fault, hold-up undervoltage, 3V3 undervoltage or buck fault
state_machine.action: POWER_SAFE_N asserts RUN low and PAYLOAD_SPI_CS_N returns high

state_machine.entry: valid power returns and reset release delay expires
state_machine.action: firmware rejects or repairs incomplete transaction states before exposure

firmware_contract: Do not disable the RP2354 brownout detector.
Do not expose an object as committed until durable metadata says committed.
Treat every reset during erase, program or metadata update as an interrupted transaction.
Validate payload NOR identity and status before recovery.
Do not start payload mutation before the USB power contract permits the required current.

evidence_claims.FACT: The cited manufacturer datasheets define the candidate parts, voltage ranges, thresholds, protection functions and RUN behavior used by this contract.
evidence_claims.DECISION: Proto-0 uses an isolated VBUS_HOLD node, a 3.3 V buck and wired-AND external reset supervision.
evidence_claims.EXPECTED: The calculated hold-up interval is expected to force a fail-stop before the payload NOR leaves its valid supply range at the 300 mA design ceiling.
evidence_claims.UNKNOWN: Native ERC, actual current, capacitance under bias and temperature, converter efficiency, power-cut timing, SPI pin quiescence, USB attach behavior, thermals and physical recovery behavior.

blocking_validation: capture the full circuit and test points in editable KiCad source
run native KiCad ERC and independent electrical review
simulate eFuse startup, buck loop/load step and abrupt input removal
measure POWER_SAFE_N, RUN, 3V3 and PAYLOAD_SPI_CS_N during repeated power cuts
prove 25 us maximum RUN-to-payload-bus-quiescent timing or revise hold-up
complete Task 5 USB-C input and inrush validation
complete Task 6 sourcing and derating review
